app.metodo_nenhum: This week's method: not chosen yet. The instructor chooses with: python3 -m estudo proximo --objetivo
app.hoje_titulo: What do you want to study today?
app.hoje_ajuda: Select only what you need. The other tabs show only what you selected. You can change this whenever you like.
app.nada_marcado: Nothing selected. Go back to Today and choose an objective.
app.redesenhe: Redraw it on paper, with arrows, before comparing.
app.revisao_geral: general review: questions only, without looking at the material
app.tarefa_estudar: study with this week's method and answer the questions
app.tarefa_revisar: review an objective you've already mastered (so you don't forget it)
app.plano_ajuda: First, what you got wrong; then, what you haven't tested yet. On the last day, questions only, without looking at the material.
app.resumo_ajuda: Black and white, with only the objectives selected in Today. Keep it in your pocket.
app.placar_titulo: Which method is working for you
app.regra_1: Before studying an objective, the method is chosen and recorded, along with the reason.
app.regra_2: The result counts toward the method most recently recorded for that objective.
app.regra_3_inteiro: Mastered = answering every question for the objective correctly (the teacher's rule).
app.regra_4: With fewer than {n} objectives, the method is marked "not enough data" and isn't called the best.
app.regra_5: This scoreboard shows what's already been imported into the kit. Today's results that haven't been imported yet:
app.dica_1: Answering questions without looking at the material helps you retain more than reading it again.
app.dica_2: A little each day over several days works better than one whole night before the exam.
app.dica_3: Switching topics during the same session helps you know which rule to use for each question.
app.dica_4_t: Explain it in your own words
app.dica_4: If you get stuck explaining it, you've found the missing piece.
app.dica_5: Draw a diagram with arrows from memory, then compare it.
app.dica_6: Got it wrong? Read the part of the source that comes with the answer, not just the answer key.
app.exportar_titulo: Send the results to the kit
app.exportar_ajuda: Download the file, then the person managing the kit runs: python3 -m estudo importar resultados.json. After that, the scoreboard and plan will include what you did.
app.regra_perde: By the teacher's rule, getting one question wrong means losing the entire objective: study the source material and try again tomorrow.
app.guardado: Result saved. Send it to the kit from the Export tab.
app.q_ajuda: Answer without looking at the material. The options change order each time you open this. After each answer, the part of the source that proves the correct answer appears.
app.sua_resposta: Your answer, in your own words

placar.lider: {nome} is in the lead for now ({dominados} of {n} objectives mastered). Keep testing: different subjects have different challenges.
placar.empate: A technical tie among methods with enough data: the difference is still too small to choose a winner.
placar.cedo: It's still too early: each method needs at least {min_n} objectives tested before you can compare them.

redesenhar.faz: Look at the process diagram, close the page, and redraw it from memory; then compare and correct it.
redesenhar.porque: Drawing from memory makes you recall the steps in order, rather than just recognize them.

explicar-falando.faz: Explain the objective to the instructor (or to your phone) in your own words, without reading.
explicar-falando.porque: Where your explanation gets stuck is exactly the point you haven't learned yet.

vida-real.faz: Connect each step to an everyday scene and describe the scene before answering.
vida-real.porque: A familiar scene gives you a hook for remembering the abstract part.

pratica-sem-consulta.faz: Answer the questions for the objective without looking at anything; only then check your answers and read the explanation for any mistakes.
pratica-sem-consulta.porque: Trying to remember (retrieval practice) helps you retain more than rereading.

releitura.faz: Reread the material and highlight what's important, the way you usually do.
releitura.porque: It's the usual approach; it serves as a comparison to see whether the other methods make a difference.

demo.motivo_visual: she learns by seeing; start with the method with the fewest tests
